name: garnet_web
description: Garnet-styled two-column web settings UI for ESP32 that replaces WiFiManager. It renders garnet_settings groups in the browser and adds built-in WiFi (scan, saved networks, captive portal), Ethernet, Bluetooth, SD card and System groups, enabled by build flag. Built on esp_http_server with the UI embedded in flash.
keywords: wifimanager, captive portal, settings, web ui, ethernet, esp32
